results.rationale: Consistency: The glass tabletop, chrome rings, clear legs, pale background and white vase with turquoise/white flowers are substantially preserved; the open book has additionally been closed, an unrequested change to its state. Instruction: The book changes from open to closed but remains to the right of the vase. A correct edit would relocate it to the left of the vase; the required side change is absent. Quality: Structural coherence, natural lighting and reflections, artifact absence and surface textures are satisfactory; the closed book, flowers and glass furniture look coherent.

Consistency: The table is reframed and its perspective and supports change substantially; the vase moves toward the center, the bouquet arrangement changes, and the book is closed with different cover imagery. Most major non-requested scene details differ. Instruction: The open book becomes a closed book but still sits to the right of the vase. The expected edit would move the original book to the left, so the requested spatial change is absent. Quality: The glass table, vase and book have coherent main shapes and plausible soft illumination, but a conspicuous translucent vase-like shape extends below the tabletop with a broad base near the floor, creating an implausible ghost object. Other surface textures are satisfactory.
